title: RenderingDevice.draw_list_draw_indirect "Frame buffer color texture is null." on Mac
body:
### Tested versions

 - On 4.4.dev4 (when draw_list_draw_indirect was introduced), the game crashes immediately.
 - On all later versions, 4.4.dev5 through 4.4.rc3, this error still exists.

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc3 - macOS Sequoia (15.3.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M4 Pro (12 threads)

### Issue description

On multiple projects, when running the RenderingDevice.draw_list_draw_indirect command results in a series of errors, after which, nothing is rendered to the screen. This has happened both in my personal project, and this MRP (an example project downloaded from the change logs of the first time draw_list_draw_indirect was added). Once I squash every other bug, I can't seem to get rid of this one.

I assume it has something to do with my using Mac, and draw_list_draw_indirect (or just Metal in general) not being fully tested on Mac. The example project below should just render some triangles to the screen, but doesn't.

(the following are important pieces of the code, but I'd need to copy the whole project code for there to be truly enough context.)
```
E 0:00:00:403   render_next_subpass: Frame buffer color texture is null.
  <C++ Error>   Parameter "tex" is null.
  <C++ Source>  drivers/metal/metal_objects.mm:679 @ render_next_subpass()
E 0:00:00:403   bind_pipeline: Render pass descriptor is null.
  <C++ Error>   Parameter "render.desc" is null.
  <C++ Source>  drivers/metal/metal_objects.mm:104 @ bind_pipeline()
E 0:00:00:403   render_draw_indirect: No pipeline set for render command buffer.
  <C++ Error>   Parameter "render.pipeline" is null.
  <C++ Source>  drivers/metal/metal_objects.mm:843 @ render_draw_indirect()
```

```
var framebuffer_format := rd.screen_get_framebuffer_format()
var primitive := RenderingDevice.RENDER_PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES

var rasterization := RDPipelineRasterizationState.new()
var multisample := RDPipelineMultisampleState.new()
var depth := RDPipelineDepthStencilState.new()
var blend := RDPipelineColorBlendState.new()
blend.attachments = [RDPipelineColorBlendStateAttachment.new()]

pipeline = rd.render_pipeline_create(shader, framebuffer_format, vertex_format, primitive, rasterization, multisample, depth, blend)
```

```
var dlist := rd.draw_list_begin_for_screen()
rd.draw_list_bind_render_pipeline(dlist, pipeline)
rd.draw_list_bind_vertex_array(dlist, vertex_array)
rd.draw_list_draw_indirect(dlist, false, indirect_args)
rd.draw_list_end()
```

### Steps to reproduce

Download the MRP, and run it. It should immediately start spewing errors into the debugger. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This is the [source](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/97247) of the MRP. It was how this feature was initially tested, and confirmed to work, so the fact that it gives me an error makes me think that this is an engine problem, not a my-garbage-code problem.

[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19046626/MRP.zip)
